# NEX Launcher project notes

- Target Windows 10 and Windows 11 with .NET 8 WPF.
- Keep the launcher lightweight and the Chinese interface consistent with the dark green and mint NEX visual identity.
- Do not copy PCL branding, artwork, or proprietary implementation.
- Do not claim account authentication, full-version downloads, public server hosting, or other integrations are implemented unless they are verified.
- Use official Minecraft authentication and respect the game EULA for server setup.
